source.title: Newry Reporter, 19 May 1949, p. 8 ("Kilkeel Rural District Council"); Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Kilkeel Rural District Council"); Newry Reporter, 16 June 1949, p. 3 ("Kilkeel Rural Council: Annual Meeting: Nationalist Voters Protest")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination (Newry Reporter, 19 May 1949, p. 8); the only contests were Ballymartin, Dunaman and Glassdrummond (Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3); sat for Annalong at the council's annual meeting a week after the poll (Newry Reporter, 16 June 1949, p. 3)

note: Triennial election of the 17 electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Three divisions were contested (Ballymartin, Dunaman, Glassdrummond); Greencastle was left unopposed when T. A. Knowles withdrew. Returned unopposed.
